data.body:
[P2] Preserve added occurrences when extracting observation deltas

If an in-place phase changes `replay.retry.attempts` from `[a, b]` to `[a, a, b]`, this emits only `[a]`. `_retain_observations` matches that element to the already retained `a`, erasing the duplicate. A subsequent deduplicated collection can therefore report `PASSED`, although the standard replay validator rejects repeated attempt IDs. The raw fragment receives no duplicate-attempt validation. Preserve occurrence counts through delta extraction and merging, and add a regression where the duplicate first appears during `place` or `execute` before collection removes it.
